items.title: Are You Sure You Understand Kinross Gold Stock's Risk?
items.summary: Kinross Gold (KGC) shares lost 27% in the past month, while the S&P 500 gained 0.5%. You may still think the business makes this a passing fall, since the miner keeps 52% of its sales as operating profit. That comfort needs two things: a business sturdier than before, and a stock that held up when markets fell.
